notes.title: Demo version of LetsGal out now
notes.notes: [p][b]Just now, we released the long-awaited demo version of "LetsGal: A Love Story in Development"![/b][/p][p]This game is an all-ages, male-oriented Galgame centered on "pure love" and girls & romance. The story follows your journey in Tokyo as you strive to "create the best Galgame" while navigating romantic relationships with 8 distinctive heroines.[/p][p]This demo features a [b]time lock[/b] set at approximately [b]1/6th of the total game length[/b], concluding at the end of [b]Spring Day 30 (Night) in Year 1[/b].[/p][p]The demo includes:[/p][list][*][p]All [b]8 heroines[/b] (4 primary launch heroines and 4 secondary heroines).[/p][/*][*][p]Several supporting characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]13 main story events[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]8 affection events[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]264 daily events[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]720,000 words of game text[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]This content represents [b]less than 30%[/b] of the planned full game. However, due to the time lock, some events requiring specific prerequisites may not trigger during this demo.[/p][p][b]Please note:[/b] This demo is still under testing and [b]may contain bugs and unbalanced game mechanics[/b]. We sincerely appreciate any feedback to help us improve![/p][p][b]Currently Unavailable in Demo (Will be added later to this demo):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Mini-games and features like "Ema" (votive tablets), "Fishing," "Game Weekly Reports," and others.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Target Release:[/b] The full version is planned for release by the [b]end of this year[/b], barring any unforeseen review-related delays.[/p][p][b]We eagerly invite all players who try the demo to share their feedback and suggestions![/b] Your input is invaluable for enhancing the final release.[/p][p][b]Thank you so much for downloading and playing![/b] We truly hope you enjoy it, even if just a little.[/p]
